title: Qatl hue abbase ali wawaila
body:
Qatl hue abbase Ali waawaila, teghe sitam shaano'n pa chali waawaila
Mashq chidi sab beh gaya paani, pyasi rahi godo'n ki pali waawaila
Gurze sitam sar par khaaya waawaila, Bhai ko sheh ke ghash aaya waawaila
Pushte faras par tham na saka tyora ke gira farzande Ali waawaila
Ediya ragdi rethi par waawaila, aaye qaree'n sab baanie shar
Di ye sada zahra ke pisar ko ya shahe waala jaan chali waawaila
